stories.summary: Odisha Chief Minister said heavy rainfall was expected in Mayurbhanj and Balasore over the next 24 hours, with its impact likely to extend to neighbouring Jajpur, Bhadrak, Kendrapara and Jagatsinghpur districts

article_sentences: Severe coastal erosion has damaged a stretch of the shoreline near the INS Kursura Submarine Museum in Visakhapatnam on Friday, November 20, 2026, as high tidal waves batter the coast under the impact of Cyclone Akvan.

Cyclone ‘Akvan’ weakened into a depression after making landfall near Gopalpur on the Odisha coast on Friday (November 20, 2026), bringing heavy rainfall but causing no major damage or loss of life, Disaster Management Minister Suresh Pujari said.

IMD Director General Mrutyunjay Mohapatra said Akvan had weakened from a severe cyclonic storm to a cyclonic storm before reaching the coast as it could not sustain its intensity due to the relatively cold sea surface temperature near the shore.
The cyclone had considerably lost its intensity when it made landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha.

“The cyclonic storm Akvan crossed the south coastal Odisha and north Andhra Pradesh close to Gopalpur with a wind speed of 70-80 kmph, gusting to 90 kmph during 7.30 a.m. to 8.30 a.m.,” said the India Meteorological Department (IMD).
Landfall of Cyclone Akvan nears Odisha and Andhra Pradesh coasts as land interaction begins, with heavy rainfall and prolonged impact anticipated.
